detail.longDescription: From the Archive to the Arena How a Rodeo Night Inspired My Fiction Writing Process Last night, I went to the rodeo at the New Mexico State Fair. I went to enjoy an evening with people I love, watch the rodeo, and hear the Turnpike Troubadours. But somewhere between the opening of the first chute and the final song of the night, I was also working. That is what happens when a novelist goes to the rodeo while writing a rodeo novel.
